notes:
Generated by tool_search_cases_test.go from testdata/tool-search/ — edit the corpus or the intents and regenerate, never this file. Groups are <lang>-<match|nomatch>: `nomatch` is the arm where the right answer is no tool at all, and every tool the gate lets through there is a wrong tool offered to the model. Pairs link the zh and en forms of one intent, which is where a language-shaped threshold shows up. Per-case instructions ARE the production question text (see the design doc §六).

question.instructions: The state is a request from the user. Decide whether the tool described below can carry that request out directly.
question.yes: Calling this tool now would directly carry out what the request asks for.
question.no: The request asks for something else, or this tool needs input the request does not provide, or its action is only RELATED to what was asked rather than the same action.
